instruction: The claim window in the ferry-boats remission order is being extended from two years to three. Make the order right.
why: A real bilingual federal instrument, where the English and French versions are equally authoritative and the claim period is stated once in each. An edit to the English half alone leaves the French half saying something different, which is the specific defect this family exists to catch — and nothing in the instruction says there are two versions. Four dated provisions elsewhere in the order, two in each language, must not move.

targets.pattern: within three years after the date of importation
dans les trois ans suivant la date d’importation

guards.pattern: le 1er octobre 2015 ou après cette date

reference_edits.find: within two years after the date of importation
reference_edits.replace: within three years after the date of importation

reference_edits.find: dans les deux ans suivant la date d’importation
reference_edits.replace: dans les trois ans suivant la date d’importation

reference_answer: Paragraph 2(b) now reads three years in the English version and « dans les trois ans » in the French. Both versions of this order are equally authoritative, so I changed the period in each; the importation date and the coming-into-force dates are unchanged in both.

near_misses.why: changed the English version and left the equally authoritative French version saying two years

edits.find: within two years after the date of importation
edits.replace: within three years after the date of importation

edits.find: dans les deux ans suivant la date d’importation
edits.replace: dans les trois ans suivant la date d’importation

near_misses.why: treated every period in the order as the period being extended
